RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel for a senior appointment can suggest structural underrepresentation or unconscious affinity bias, especially when the candidates' credentials differ between technical expertise and general management. However, panel composition alone is circumstantial and does not constitute proof of discrimination; hiring often hinges on interview performance and perceived organizational fit.

Avoid directly raising allegations of sex discrimination at this stage. Instead, follow up politely on your requested written debrief. If your hospital or public health authority has explicit recruitment policies requiring diverse interview panels, you can ask HR neutrally whether procedure was followed. Consult a union representative, staff ombudsperson, or legal advisor before pursuing any formal grievance.
